gloss: to let something slip; to say something by mistake

definitions.gloss: to let something slip; to blurt out; to make a slip of the tongue
definitions.explanation: To accidentally say something that should have been kept secret or that one did not intend to reveal. Literally 'to let one's mouth slide.'

examples.japanese: つい⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滑|すべ}らせて→滑る：01230_suberu⟧しまった。
⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っていた→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滑|すべ}らせて→滑る：01230_suberu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I knew the secret but ended up blurting it out.

examples.japanese: ⟦サプライズ→サプライズ：10936_sapuraizu⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滑|すべ}らせて→滑る：01230_suberu⟧⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally let it slip to the person about the surprise party.

notes:
USAGE:
This expression is almost always used with てしまう to convey the accidental, regrettable nature of the slip. The subject is always the person who blurted something out.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The verb ⟦{滑|すべ}らす→滑らす：17573_suberasu⟧ is a godan verb. In practice, the te-form ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滑|すべ}らせて→滑る：01230_suberu⟧ is the most common form encountered.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧しまう (to carelessly say something)
- ⟦{失言|しつげん}→失言：12189_shitsugen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a verbal gaffe — more formal)
